This is the language you speak, not the language of the menus. For recognition without internet, install the offline language pack in the speech settings of your phone (Google app → Settings → Voice → Offline speech recognition).
Speech is processed on the phone when the language pack is installed. Otherwise the online speech service is used.
Say “comma”, “full stop”, “question mark” or “new line” to insert them.

• Audio is never saved to a file. The microphone stream goes straight to the speech recognition service of your phone and only the resulting text comes back.

• Messages and attached files stay only on this phone, in the private storage of the app, and are deleted automatically after the period you chose, or immediately when you clear the conversation. Attached files are copies; your originals are not touched.

• Recognition is done by the speech service installed on your phone (usually Google). With on-device recognition the audio does not leave the phone. With the online service your audio is sent to that provider for transcription under its own privacy policy.

• Text and files leave the app only when you send them to another app (Viber, WhatsApp, e-mail, ChatGPT…). From there the rules of that app apply.

Tiho turns what you say into readable text messages, for moments when playing or recording audio is not appropriate: meetings, the office, public transport.\n\nSpeak, check the text, attach a document or photo if needed, and send it on through Viber, WhatsApp, e-mail or ChatGPT.

Tiho has no server and no accounts. A message reaches another person through an app you already use: Tiho hands over the text and files, and you pick the contact there.
• This app has no internet permission, no account, no ads and no analytics.

Adds the capital letter, a full stop or question mark, and commas before words like “but” or “че”, “защото”. It follows simple rules and can miss.
